statement: GPT-5.6 Luna xhigh under the exact structured-owner-duty Codex 0.147.0 realization may prepare one provenance-bounded memo candidate from reviewed inputs without promoting it into durable canon, but this remains a real-work canary hypothesis until a memo-owner-reviewed duty demonstrates the role.

conditions: the memo owner, reviewed evidence inputs, lifecycle target and named candidate output are explicit
the actor preserves provenance and prepares rather than confirms durable memory
the work runs in an isolated projection with effects bounded by the mandate
the result returns to the memo owner for admission, quarantine or no-write review
the exact Codex 0.147.0 realization passes the live catalog check
the bound abyss-stack external actor runtime is artifact-admitted before launch
usage is counted from runtime receipts and never becomes a caller-authored execution budget
exclusions: automatic promotion into durable memory or owner truth
inventing provenance, review state, lifecycle or source authority
copying private raw evidence into a public or stronger-owner surface
autonomous commit, push, merge, publication or undelegated external effect
treating a polished narrative as reviewed memory
inferring closed-model internal geometry or training lineage from behavior

evidence_refs.notes: Adjacent structured external-work evidence only; it does not prove memory-keeper fit.
Confirms the exact Luna xhigh and max realizations under Codex 0.147.0.
Provider capabilities and economics only; not AoA role-fit evidence.

freshness.policy: Current only for one evidence-complete real-work memo canary; its memo-owner review must strengthen, narrow, weaken or stale the claim.

history.reason: Current provider/runtime facts and adjacent bounded external-work evidence justify one real-duty canary, not transferred proof.

attribution_limits: No Luna memo-role run under this exact claim has completed.
Adjacent landing evidence does not establish memory-keeper fit or net benefit.
Provider capabilities and pricing do not prove task performance.
The first canary may prepare a candidate but cannot confirm or promote durable memory.
